reported_failure: On Scepter of Sargeras, clicking a base-tree trait locks further purchases until the artifact UI is reopened. The separate empowered circle accepts points normally. User confirms a base trait remains3 after reopening, rather than increasing to4.
saved_state_read_only: Scepter128941 is already empowered (tier1); the original nine minor traits remain purchasedRank3, while newer circle traits have purchased ranks. No character data is changed for this repair.
root_cause: Player's online tier transition calls Item::InitArtifactsTier after setting ITEM_MODIFIER_ARTIFACT_TIER. That method clears the entire m_artifactPowerIdToIndex lookup, then indexes only the newly appended tier powers. Existing base/relic records remain in the visible dynamic field, but GetArtifactPower returns null for them. HandleArtifactAddPower then returns without rank change or XP deduction. The client begins its purchase animation and has no successful authoritative rank update. Closing the UI clears the client's pending state but cannot restore the missing server lookup.
implementation: Keep the existing index when appending empowered-tier records. Existing base, relic and previously learned tier powers retain their indexes and ranks; repeated initialization adds no duplicates. Log the scoped tier transition for runtime implementation verification. Purchase packet format, costs, effects, rank limits, forge admission and saves are unchanged.
recovery: Canonical worldserver restart causes the native LoadArtifactData path to rebuild existing indexes from persisted ranks. No quest reset, talent refund, AP replacement, item grant or personal database migration is needed. The code change prevents a later online empowerment from breaking them again.
automated_checks: ArtifactPowerCatalog.cpp reads actual Artifact, ArtifactPower, ArtifactPowerRank and ArtifactPowerLink.db2 through the production DB2Storage reader. The fixture excludes display-only joke artifacts with no rankable base tree; it covers all36 playable class artifacts.

Test-ArtifactTierProgression.ps1 compiles the production InitArtifactPowers, InitArtifactsTier, GetArtifactPower, SetArtifactPower, total-rank counter and complete HandleArtifactAddPower. Baseline fails after the real tier transition with 'base/relic lookup lost after upgrade, artifact2 power40'.

Fixed fixture passes36 artifacts and324 sequential native base-rank purchases (including Scepter804 from3 to4), real DB2 rank/link lookup, exact64-bit XP deduction, forge/insufficient-XP/replayed-request rejection, preservation of relic bonuses and already purchased circle ranks, repeated tier initialization and Scepter data reconstruction on reload. No reopen operation is supplied between purchases.

UI source corroboration: Blizzard_ArtifactPowerButton.lua7.3.5 invokes C_ArtifactUI.AddPower before starting the purchase animation; Blizzard_ArtifactUI.lua clears the API state on hide. The fixture does not emulate the closed-source C_ArtifactUI pending-state implementation or actual client packet delivery.
existing_client_addon: Read-only inspection of LegionArtifactCloseFix found only the close-button frame-level repair. It is not changed by this server fix.
separate_audit_findings: The preexisting automatic empowerment refund accumulator starts from GetUInt32Value(ITEM_FIELD_ARTIFACT_XP), although AP is64-bit; this narrow index repair does not reconstruct any prior AP loss. HandleArtifactAddPower also processes only Powers[0]; multi-power packet behavior is outside this regression. Neither issue is needed to explain the confirmed unchanged3-to4 rank and broken base-tree lookup.
